correctness.rationale: On normalized ball Bergman monomials, radial derivative contributes N and integration t^(N+k-1) gives N/(N+k); multiplication by z_(h+1)^k yields monomial norm ratio sqrt((alpha_(h+1)+k)!/alpha_(h+1)!*(N+d)!/(N+d+k)!). Distinct target multi-indices make T*T diagonal. Group transverse beta and undamped total M; each asymptotic weight is A_beta M^(-k/2) with C(M+h-1,h-1) multiplicity. Cumulative undamped count ~L^h/h! yields t^(2h/k) N(t)->(1/h!)sum_beta A_beta^(2h/k), summable by geometric transverse damping. Monotone counting inversion proves s_n~C^(1/q)n^(-1/q), sharp p>q, weak endpoint and C log n q-sum. For d=2,h=k=1,r=.5, independent cutoffs t=.05,.02,.01,.005 give scaled counts 1.6825,1.7572,1.7715,1.775925 approaching exact C=16/9. Examined frozen check.py; no finite test replaces dominated convergence.
